entries.source: Also, USD files can only be saved when the model as been loaded from a USD file. If you want to save a model that has been loaded from another file format, you must save it as FBX or OBJ.
Note that OBJ files can only store a single UV set(single channel).If you wish to work with several UV channels, consider using FBX or USD format.
- Back Only, displays only the back faces.This mode is helpful to isolate and fix polygons with inverted normals.
- Front Only, displays only the front faces.Back faces are hidden, making it easier to spot flipped normals or incorrectly oriented polygons.

- Front Shaded / Back Solid Color, renders front faces normally(with shading) while displaying back faces in a solid color.This makes backfaces easy to identify while keeping a realistic preview of the overall geometry."
Anti-Aliasing Sample Count Channel A$$Anti aliasing sample count for rendering polygons
Anti-Aliasing Sample Count Channel B$$Anti aliasing sample count for rendering polygons
Apply Texel Density$$Once you've picked or set your Texel Density, clicking the Apply Density icon scales selection to the specified texel density.
Auto deselect islands after isolate action
Auto Isolate Island$$Enable/Disable automatic islands isolation. When on, islands which haven't any edge selected will be automatically hidden.
Auto Save File Amount$$Auto save file amount
Auto Save Folder Path Browser$$Opens a file selector to select folder to save backup files into.
Auto Save Folder Path$$Auto save feature will save the backup files into that folder.
Auto Save Time Interval$$Auto save time interval in minutes

Average Normal Projection$$Project 3D geometry using the average normal of each islands or each isolated group of selected primitives. Applied on selection if non-empty or on everything in the contrary case.
Back Face Rendering$$-Front and Back: Displays both front and back faces with the same shading.Useful for quickly visualizing the entire geometry without distinction.
Background Color Channel A$$Background color mode
Background Color Channel B$$Background color mode is selected
Background Mode Channel A$$Background rendering mode
Background Mode Channel B$$Background rendering mode
Box Info File Path$$Box info file path
Browse defined hotkeys, click one of them then compose the Hotkey. Right Click to unassign.
Browse External Text Editor Path$$Show a file selector that allows to select your program editor.
Browse Remote Control File$$Remote Control File Path
Cancel Current Config Edition$$Revert the hotkey and mouse interaction configuration to the state they had when the dialog has been opened.
Center Selection$$Center View on the selection set.
Children Count Display Limit$$Limit the children number displayed into the explorer tree to mitigate display update slowness in presence of large island count
Close Exporter Dialog$$Close the exported dialog.
Color Map and Selection Bar$$The color map an selection bar shows relation between the viewport polygon's color and various numerical values, and allows to select islands and primitives.
Compress in LZW$$Compress the Tiff file in LZW format
Constrain Edge(s) Horizontally$$Constrain the selected edges to be horizontal when unfolding and optimizing. You need to update optimize to see the effects.
Constrain Edge(s) Vertically$$Constrain the selected edges to be vertical when unfolding and optimizing. You need to update optimize to see the effects.
Copy Host ID To Clipboard$$Copy Host ID text to clipboard so that you will not make mistake when pasting it in the website when (re)generating your license file.
Cropped File Path$$Cropped OBJ file path
Custom File Path Enabled$$Use a custom file path pattern.
Cut$$Use in edge, polygon mode to create seams on the mesh. If the selection is empty, the edge located under the mouse pointer will be cut.
Debug Log File Path$$The debug command log file contains useful information that can be used to fix issues.

Delete Unused UV Sets$$If enabled, UV sets that have zero flattened polygons won't be exported in the file. In presence of multiple UV sets, if such a completely not flattened UV set would be located in the first UV set, the second UV set (flattened) will be placed in the first one!

Density$$Switch to edit mode density multiplier map. Once edited, a value of the density multiplier different from zero will change the UV polygon's area after running optimize. Packing will also take account the density multiplier map by giving island different scales, and hotspot will do as well.
Distribute in New Groups Using Group File Data$$Distribute islands in new groups  by group ID.
Distribute in New Groups Using Material File Data$$Distribute islands in new groups by material ID.
Distribute in New Groups Using Object File Data$$Distribute islands in new groups by object ID.
Distribute in New Groups Using Smoothing File Data$$Distribute islands in new groups by smoothing groups ID.
Distribute in Tiles Using Group File Data$$Distribute islands in available tiles by group ID.
Distribute in Tiles Using Material File Data$$Distribute islands in available tiles by material ID.
Distribute in Tiles Using Object File Data$$Distribute islands in available tiles by object ID.
Distribute in Tiles Using Smoothing Group File Data$$Distribute islands in available tiles by smoothing groups ID.
Distribute Locked Islands$$Distribute islands even if they are located into locked tiles or locked groups or if they are locked.
DXF Borders File Path$$The path of the file used to export the boundary edges of the islands
Edge Based Symmetry Detection$$Set the symmetry map using the current edge selection (only on edge must be selected). Only the mesh topology is read, the 3D coordinates are ignored.
Edge Based Symmetry Detection$Shift-S$Set the symmetry map using the current edge selection (only on edge must be selected). Only the mesh topology is read, the 3D coordinates are ignored.
Edge Padding Size Channel A$$Edge padding duplicates the pixels along the inside of the UV edge and spreads those colors outward, forming a skirt of similar colors.
Edge Padding Size Channel B$$Edge padding duplicates the pixels along the inside of the UV edge and spreads those colors outward, forming a skirt of similar colors.
Edge Rendering Color Channel A$$Edge rendering color
Edge Rendering Color Channel B$$Edge rendering color
Edge Rendering Mode Channel A$$Edge rendering mode
Edge Rendering Mode Channel B$$Edge rendering mode
Edge$$Lets you select and work at edge level
Enable Auto Deselected After isolate$$If enabled, island will be automatically deselected after an isolate action
Enable Partial UV Sets$$If enabled, non flat polygons and their associated UV nodes will not be exported. Warning: this options may not be compatible with all 3D Software.
Enable/Disable$$Enable/Disable symmetry mode for selection, unfolding and edition
Enabled Auto Save$$Auto save feature save your current project into FBX file regularly.
Execute Selected Script$$Execute the selected part of the script

Export Borders in DXF$$Exports the boundaries as LWPOLYLINEs in a DXF file. Current scene units are used to specify the DXF units. Scene units are set from the input file or set to 'cm' as default. If you need to set the file unit, open the UV Set panel and use the Scene unit controller.
Export Borders Only Channel A$$Export UV mesh borders only in the tiff file
Export Borders Only Channel B$$Export UV mesh borders only in the tiff file
Export Box Info$$Export cropped box/tile dimensions in a text file
Export Channel A$$Enable export of rasterized UV in a image file using channel A's settings
Export Channel B$$Enable export of rasterized UV in a image file using channel B's settings
Export Current Config to File$$Export the hotkey and mouse interaction current configuration into a file.
Export Files$$Export files using current settings.
Export Tile Shape in DXF$$Export Tile shape as an additional poly line in the DXF File
Export Tile Shape in Quad$$Export Tile shape as a Quad in the OBJ File
Export UV in 3D$$Export UV space in the 3D space of the OBJ File
Extend License$$Show this license into license account page using the default web browser
External Text Editor$$Your favorite text and script editor program path.
FBX Compatibility Version$$FBX compatibility version chosen at import and export.
FBX order UV sets by their name
File Browser$$Display a file browser that enables you to select a file path and name for saving your data.
File Browser$$Show a file selector that allows to select a file name.
File Format Channel A$$File Format For Channel A
File Format Channel B$$File Format For Channel A
File Path Channel A$$Channel A file path
File Path Channel B$$Channel A file path
Filling Direction$$Filling direction when distributing selected group into the grid.
Fit$$Rescale selected islands to fit the UV Square (without deforming them)
Grid Texture Path$$The path of the tile texture which is displayed when the texture mode is set to Texture Grid. Clear text to revert the built-in numerated grid texture.
Group Overlapped$$Detect overlapped island sets and create groups for all of them.
Group$$Create a new elastic group using the current island/group selection. An elastic groups adapt its shape to the size of its content.
Hide Selected/Hovered Island(s)$$Hide selected islands or the island under the mouse.
Horizontalize$$Aligns selected edges or points on a horizontal axis

Hotspot Mapping$$Transform selected islands and groups to fit the available Trims, based on their geometry. Please note that you can hover over an island at any time and press 'S' to hotspot it, even when you're in a mode other than the island selection mode.
HUD Text$$Text color of the HUD displaying texel density information.
Import and Export island groups, island properties, pin map and edge constrains.
Import and Export RizomUV attributes$$Import and export island groups, island properties, pin map, and edge constrains from and to files.

Import Auto Weld$$Automatically weld UV edges that are perfectly superposed and sharing the same original edge in 3D space. This feature should be activated especially when all your UV polygons are separated after importing the file.
Import Current Config from File$$Import the hotkey and mouse interaction configuration from a file.
Import User Normals$$Import user normals from model files. If unchecked normals will be replaced by polygon's geo-normals.
Island and Groups$$Lets you select and work with islands, groups, tiles and trims
License File Browser$$Open directory browser to set the license file

License Manager$$This feature enables you to comprehensively manage your license. It provides visibility into various details such as the license ID, licensee, expiration date of the rental license, and the status of both the rental and perpetual licenses.
List Assigned Features$$List the features that have a hotkey assigned
Load User Texture Map...$Ctrl-T$Load a texture from an image file (used in both viewports shading)
Local$$Enable/Disable symmetry local mode. When enabled, symmetric islands will remain at their place while their symmetric counterparts are translated.
Lock$$Forbid island or group transformation for the packing algorithm.
Long Press Delay$$Number of milliseconds before the popup window appears when a button is long - pressed.
Low Part Background Color$$3D viewport low part gradient color
Luminant Texture$$Enable/Disable luminant texture. When enabled the texture becomes unaffected by lighting and shading
Menu's recent file list ignore UV data
Mesh Wire Color$$Mesh wire color when polygons are not displayed
Mesh Wire Over Poly Color$$Mesh wire color when polygons are displayed and the edge is the primitive selection mode
Mesh Wire Over Polys Color$$Mesh wire color when polygons are displayed
Mouse Interaction Model Preset$$Mouse interaction model preset
Multi threading$$Enable or disable multi threading
New: Right click on a controller's to set its default value based on its current state.
Normalize Tile For Exported File$$Normalize exported UVs to fit the shape of an unity square.
Normalize Tile For UV In 3D$$Normalize UV in 3D file so that current tile will lie have a shape of a unity square.

Note that the primitive selection mode has an impact on the selection behavior. In primitive edge selection mode, this dialog will select the polygon set's borders, not the edges that are included in them.
Omniverse Browser$$Show a file browser that allows to select a file on Omniverse.
Omniverse Client Log Level$$Control the verbose level of the NVidia Omniverse service.
Open Debug Log File Path Location$$Open the debug log file folder using the file explorer.

Optimize$$Running Optimize on a flattened geometry will decrease distortion even more in most cases and on most islands. Depending of your primitive selection mode, this option optimizes your flattened islands, depending on whether they are selected, have a mouse-over, or consist of a single island selection
Optimize$$Switch to edit mode brush optimize
Order UV Set by Names$$Group all object's UV sets using their names. If disabled, they will grouped using their channel index
Pack After Distribute$$Run the packing algorithm for all tiles in which islands have been added.
Pack Translate$$Packs selected or all islands if none are selected, but keeps their current orientation and scale
Pack$$Packs selected, or all islands if none are selected
Parallelize Edges$$Transform selected groups of edges so that they become parallel.
Perspective$$Switch from perspective mode to orthographic mode

Pick Texel Density$$Using the Pick Texel Density eyedropper picks the Texel Density from the current selection. If nothing is selected, RizomUV calculates the average Texel Density of all visible islands. You can also set your Texel Density manually in the spinner-field next to the eyedropper.
Pin$$Pin Selected point(s) or edge(s) or face(s)
Pin$$Switch to edit mode brush pin map. The map influence unfold and optimize algorithms. The more the vertexes are dark, the less they will be moved.
Polygon Filling Color Channel A$$Polygon color when Color polygon color mode is selected
Polygon Filling Color Channel B$$Polygon color when Color polygon color mode is selected
Polygon Filling Mode Channel A$$Polygon rendering mode
Polygon Filling Mode Channel B$$Polygon rendering mode
Polygon Groups$$The Polygon Groups dialog allows you to select and distribute islands based on object, material, group, or smoothing group present in the model file.
Polygon$$Lets you select and work at polygon level
Preference Tab Focus$$Select which tab is currently displayed in the preference window
Preferences Anti Aliasing Disabled$$Anti aliasing in viewports disabled
Preferences Enable Anti Aliasing$$Activate anti aliasing in viewports
Preferences Far Plane$$Viewport far plane distance from camera
Preferences File Name Suffix$$Optional file suffix automatically added when saving file.
Preferences Near Plane$$Near plane clipping distance to eye. Lowest values can create artifacts (z-fighting)
Preferences Reset All$$Revert all preferences, layouts, color settings, brush configurations, and other customizations to their factory values.
Preferences Undo History Size$$Number of undo steps
Protect$$Switch to edit mode paint protect/attract map. This map influence the shortest path selection, and also prevent AutoSeams to select edges.
Ratio Mode$$Image W&&H ratio linking mode
Re-execute Selected Log Text$$Re-execute the selected part of the log
Recent file list open 3D data only$$When enabled, loading a file using the Recent file list (see menu File) will ignore the UV data present in the file.
Rectangularize Polygons Horizontally$$Make the selected polygons rectangular then orient the result horizontally
Rectangularize Polygons Vertically$$Make the selected polygons rectangular then orient the result vertically
Rectangularize Polygons$$Make the selected polygons rectangular
Remote Control File Enabled$$Activate the remote control by file. Once activated, RizomUV will execute the commands in the file each time the file's date is modified.
Remote Control File Path$$Remote control script file path.
Repeat Last Action$$Repeat last action on the current selection set.
Repeat Last Two Actions$$Repeat the last two actions on the current selection set.
Reset all Hotkeys to Built-in$$Revert all hotkeys to their built-in values.
Reset License Location$$Reset the license location so that the license activation is shown at next start.
Revert all Hotkeys to Saved$$Revert all hotkeys to the state they had when the dialog has been opened.
Rotate 90 ClockWise$$Rotate selection by 90 degrees clock wise.
Rotate 90 CounterClockWise$$Rotate selection by 90 degrees counter clock wise.
Save Current Config for Next Sessions$$Save the hotkey and mouse interaction configuration into the preference file for next session.
Save File$$Save model in a file.
Save$$RizomUV can export various file formats such as universal scene description (USD), Autodesk FBX, and OBJ files.
Script Language$$Select in which language the script in the editor should be interpreted
Script Log Window$$Show script and log window.
See Selection Through$$Makes the edge selection visible behind the polygons

Select Borders$$Select points or edges located on selection's island borders. If some edges are selected on the borders, only the border that have some edges selected will be selected, same for vertexes
Select Edge Loop$$Switch to edge loop selection tool as primary too
Select Loops$$Selects a run of loops starting from your current edge selection
Select Overlaps$$Selects overlapping polygons. In Island Mode (F4) it will select islands which have at least one triangle overlapping other triangles
Select Shortest Path$$Switch to shortest path edge selection as primary tool

Select Similar$$Provided that your islands are similar enough, Select Similar copies your selection across islands with the same topology. As of version 2020.1.100, this also includes islands, the selection process is no longer limited to edges.
Select$$Switch to edit mode selection (TIP: Press TAB for rapid access to Trans/Rot/Scal Gizmo)
Show Borders$$Switch on/off borders/seams visibility. Be careful when disabled, you will not see the effect of cut operations, which can be error prone.
Show Both$$Show flat and not flat islands.
Show Dialog...$$Show / Hide the symmetry dialog.
Show Not Flats$$Show not flat islands (i.e: islands that are not yet unfolded)
Show the hotkeys settings$$Expand Show the hotkeys settings panel
SHOW THIS LICENSE IN RIZOM-LAB ACCOUNT
Show Viewport Interaction$$Expand Show Viewport Interaction panel
Shows FBX Settings Dialog$$Shows FBX settings when using 'Load As' and 'Save As' features
Shows FBX settings when using 'Load As' and 'Save As'
Squarify$$Rescale selected Islands to fit the UV Square. PLEASE NOTE: Squarify may cause the islands to be slightly deformed. This happens as Squarify fit the islands into both UV tile dimensions
Stack and Group Similar$$Stack and Group Similar copies the seams and UV coordinates of the islands into a stack, provided their similarity matches your criteria.
Stack Similar$$Stack Similar copies the seams and the UV coordinates of the islands so they form a stack, provided that they have sufficient similarity.
Switch UV and 3D Viewport$$Switch UV and 3D viewport visibility
Symmetry B.Box Center$$Set the axis plane position to the object bounding box, or bounding box of the current selection
Symmetry UV Space Axis Position$$UV space axis position
Symmetry Vertex Tolerance$$Threshold distance value for symmetry detection
Symmetry World Origin$$Set the axis plane position to the world origin
Symmetry XY$$Set the symmetry plane orientation to XY
Symmetry YZ$$Set the symmetry plane orientation to YZ
Symmetry ZX$$Set the symmetry plane orientation to ZX
Text Size$$Rendered text size in pixel
Tile Texture File Browser$$Opens a file selector to select a program file name.
TIP: In primitive edge selection mode, this dialog will select the polygon set's borders, not the edges that are included in them.
To change or create an hotkey please follow the instructions:

Toggle Isolate Selected/Hovered Island(s)$$Isolate selected islands or the island under the mouse. If nothing is selected, this will make visible all islands, excluding the ones that have been hidden using "Hide Selected".
Transform$$Show transform tool when selection is non-empty (Hit TAB key to display the tool whenever this button is down or not).
UI Foreground Foreground  Color$$UI foreground color
UI Scaling$$Main UI and panels size scaling factor
Unconstrain Edge(s)$$Removes constrains on edges. On all edges if none selected, on the edges included in current primitive selection.

Unfold$$Depending of your primitive selection mode, this option unwraps your islands, depending on whether they are selected, have a mouse-over, consist of a single island selection, or islands which have been cut but not flattened yet
Unfold$$Switch to edit mode brush unfold
Ungroup$$Remove selected island/group from their respective group.
UnPin$$Unpins selected point(s). Unpin all points if none selected. Can be also applied on island selection.
Up Part Background Color$$3D viewport up part gradient color
Up Vector$$Orient the view so that the selected vector is Up and use appropriate rotation axises

Use Tile's Real Space Dimensions$$The exported document size and scaling will reflect the real space dimensions of the UV tile and the content. Enable it when using the exported document as blueprint to create object of the physical world in particular. If disabled, the document will get the dimensions specified in by the Width and Height parameter of the exporter, scaling may occur.
Use tile's real space width and height
UV Background Color$$UV viewport background color
UV in 3D File Path$$UV in 3D OBJ file path
UV Pixel Grid Color$$UV Pixel Grid color
Vertex$$Lets you select and work at vertex level
Verticalize$$Aligns selected edges or points on a vertical axis
Visit License In Account$$Show this license into license account page using the default web browser.
Visit User Account$$Load licensee's account page into default web browser.
W&H Units$$Image width and height unit

Weld Island Cut$$Weld Island Cuts will weld these back independently without welding across islands if an island on your model has been given several cuts. It will only weld the cuts on the selected or moused - over island.

Weld Islands$$If you have cut your mesh into several islands, select both sides of the cut, then Weld Islands will weld these back together. Use this when you want to weld specific islands back together and/or want to avoid a reset.
Weld$$Welds selected edges, polygons, or islands. If the selection is empty, the edge or loop located under the mouse pointer, if any, will be welded.
Wireframe over polygons in edge mode
Write Command Log Into File$$Write command log into file (for debugging purpose)
Write OpenGL Debug Into File$$Write openGL debug message into file (for debugging purpose)
You can double click on the list items to select them, or use the buttons to select or append the items to the current selection.

You can select multiple groups by holding down the Ctrl key while clicking on the groups, then click on "In tiles" or "In New Groups" whether you wan to distribute the selected groups in the available tiles or in new groups.
